correction_20260802: Original 'flips 3 cells' claim was WRONG. These cells run a full AF_INET loopback and fail at connect() (executor.rs:4810 accepts only AF_UNIX -> EAFNOSUPPORT) BEFORE reaching the new getsockopt(SO_INCOMING_CPU) arm. The added arm is correct golden parity and unit-tested, but is necessary-not-sufficient: cells stay KVM-fail until AF_INET loopback connect is supported. See PR #345 correction comment.
